attributes.board_name: West Virginia Board of Physical Therapy

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved CE (1 unit = 1 clock hour). Courses sponsored by APTA, WVPTA, BOC or a CAPTE-accredited school are automatically approved; other courses need Board approval. ABPTS specialty exam/recertification or HTCC exam = 24 hours in the year taken; APTA-credentialed residency/fellowship = 24 hours; FSBPT practice review tool = 8 hours (no more than every other renewal period); clinical instruction of CAPTE students 4 weeks = 1 unit; clinical instruction + competency tools max 8 units per period; instructors 1 unit per hour taught (once).
rules.new_licensee_rule: A new graduate does not need CE hours for the current year of graduation.
rules.audit_note: Proof of CE must be uploaded before renewal, and licensees attest compliance. Each February 10% of active PT/PTA licensees are randomly audited; failing licensees sign a CE audit agreement with remedial actions.
rules.legal_basis: W. Va. Code R. §16-1-12 (16CSR1, effective April 7, 2026); 16CSR4 fees
rules.notes: Renewal season October 1 - December 31 of the year the license expires; no grace period (license becomes delinquent). Volunteer licensees need 20 units per two-year cycle. Waivers for illness, disability or hardship must be requested by October 1 of the year before renewal.
